description: Clean-room SandTie H3 full-body choreography vocabulary anchored in foot-to-floor contact, weight transfer, spatial travel, level changes, and crisp beat-synced dime-stops.

pacing_rules.motion_language: Use grounded kinetic verbs with crisp hit-and-hold timing ('plants weight onto the left heel and snaps into a clean dime-stop', 'drives diagonally across the floor', 'drops into a low wide knee lunge and locks') rather than vague continuous swaying ('glides', 'melts', 'sways', 'undulates'). Follow dynamic hits with brief beat-synced holds so H3 locks clean shapes.
pacing_rules.anatomy_order: Build every beat from the ground up: explicit foot-to-floor contact and weight transfer (planted heel, ball-of-foot pivot, wide athletic stance, cross-step travel), knee bend and extension, hip drive over the weighted leg, torso twist, clean arm lines, and reactive hair/fabric inertia.
pacing_rules.orientation_lock: Default to full-body head-to-footwear framing unless a close-up cut is explicitly requested. State initial body facing, stance width, and floor position in [Shot 1], and track left/right/forward/back floor travel in every beat.
pacing_rules.fingertip_rule: Pair sharp wrist hinges, finger-frames, and arm angles with active footwork, weight shifts, or level drops so hands accent full-body choreography rather than stationary hand-waving.
